name: openkumi
description: Open-source, local-first AI bots with subagents and a persistent browser per bot.
author: OpenKumi contributors

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @openkumi/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @openkumi/server && npm run test -w @openkumi/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @openkumi/desktop
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run dist -w @openkumi/desktop -- --dir
